entries.dialogueText: "Finally... Duke Axel Reinhart will transfer his authority to the newly established Parliament of Pales, of which half of the representatives shall be elected by the Rizian-speaking population."

entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""The cities of Ziqes and Arces, and..."
entries.dialogueText: "The cities of Ziqes and Arces, and the territories from the west to the new border from Navar to southern Remaz, according to the rights of the Kingdom of Rizia and the wishes of the Rizian population in these lands..."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""...Will be restored back to the Ki..."
entries.dialogueText: "...Will be restored back to the Kingdom of Rizia. The border as outlined in Section B is to be recognized as the new border between Rizia and Pales and will immediately be demilitarized."

entries.dialogueText: "As part of peacekeeping efforts, Rumburg will provide humanitarian aid and support both governments in their re-stabilization of the region."

entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""First of all, my deepest gratitude..."
entries.dialogueText: "First of all, my deepest gratitude to the Queen of Rumburg for supporting peace between our countries."

entries.dialogueText: "Despite this painful fact, I'm glad to have stopped the senseless bloodshed."

entries.dialogueText: "Likewise, Duke Reinhart. I'm happy the violence is over."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "I have many regrets over this war, but we must be proud to have put an end to it."

entries.dialogueText: "At the very least, I would have also preferred the complete control of Aureus, Axel. Too bad it didn't work out."

entries.dialogueText: "As the Prime Minister of Rizia, I hereby announce the complete annexation of the Grand Duchy of Pales, as part of the Treaty of Pales."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""The newly established state of Pal..."
entries.dialogueText: "The newly established state of Pales will be governed by an appointed transitionary local government until the next local elections."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "When the papers were passed to Axel..."
entries.dialogueText: When the papers were passed to Axel, I couldn't help but feel a little sad for him.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We both signed the treaty among app..."
entries.dialogueText: We both signed the treaty among applause from the Rizian delegates.

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Furthermore, in accordance with Ri..."
entries.dialogueText: "Furthermore, in accordance with Rizian law, Axel Reinhart and the members of the Reinhart family will stand trial for their crimes against the Palesian and Rizian people."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""As the Prime Minister of Rizia, I..."
entries.dialogueText: "As the Prime Minister of Rizia, I hereby announce our decision to agree to the terms of the treaty as discussed."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We would need to resort to extraord..."
entries.dialogueText: We would need to resort to extraordinary measures to pay it on time.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I would need to find a way to pay i..."
entries.dialogueText: I would need to find a way to pay it back on time.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""It was beautiful...""
entries.dialogueText: "It was beautiful..."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""In addition, Rizian government ple..."
entries.dialogueText: "In addition, Rizian government pledges to repair and fully restore the housing and infrastructure in the annexed territories at a cost of 15 billion RG."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""In addition, Rizian government ple..."
entries.dialogueText: "In addition, Rizian government pledges to repair and fully restore the housing and infrastructure in the annexed territories at a cost of 40 billion RG."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""In addition, Rizian government ple..."
entries.dialogueText: "In addition, Rizian government pledges to repair and fully restore the housing and infrastructure in the annexed territories at a cost of 75 billion RG."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""The investment will be made in ins..."
entries.dialogueText: "The investment will be made in installments over the course of 5 years."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I was taken aback when I heard the..."
entries.dialogueText: I was taken aback when I heard the amount needed to incorporate our reclaimed lands and make use of their resources. It made me wonder where that money would come from.

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Effective immediately, the estates..."
entries.dialogueText: "Effective immediately, the estates and enterprises owned by the Palesian nobility, along with all collaborators of the Reinhart family, will be seized and placed under national control."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Rizia agrees to relinquish control..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia agrees to relinquish control of the Palesian Administrative District, which is currently occupied by Pales, to the Palesian authorities."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""The Rizian government will ensure..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Rizian government will ensure the safe return of all displaced populations as well as prisoners of war..."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""The Palesian government will also..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Palesian government will also ensure the safe return of all prisoners of war and hostages, including Princess Vina Toras, who is still held captive by the Grand Duchy."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Rizia agrees to immediately withdr..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia agrees to immediately withdraw its forces from all occupied territories and ensuring a return to the pre-war borders between the two countries, marked by River Alca in the north."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""The Rizian government will ensure..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Rizian government will ensure the safe return of all displaced populations as well as prisoners of war..."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Additionally, Rizia will assume th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Additionally, Rizia will assume the rights and control of half of the Aureus Gas Field."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Finally, the Rizian government aff..."
entries.dialogueText: "Finally, the Rizian government affirms and accepts the responsibility for the loss of lives and damages."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""...And affirms and accepts the res..."
entries.dialogueText: "...And affirms and accepts the responsibility for the loss of lives and damages."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""According to assessments by both R..."
entries.dialogueText: "According to assessments by both Rizian and Palesian experts, the damage to local infrastructure is limited, justifying the payment of 15 billion RG in reparations to Pales."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""According to the assessments by bo..."
entries.dialogueText: "According to the assessments by both Rizian and Palesian experts, the damage to local infrastructure is moderate, justifying the payment of 40 billion RG in reparations to Pales."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""According to assessments by both R..."
entries.dialogueText: "According to assessments by both Rizian and Palesian experts, the damage to local infrastructure is substantial, justifying the payment of 75 billion RG in reparations to Pales."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""The reparations will be paid in in..."
entries.dialogueText: "The reparations will be paid in installments over the course of 5 years."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I was taken aback when I heard the..."
entries.dialogueText: I was taken aback when I heard the amount of reparations. It made me wonder where that money would come from.

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""First of all, thank you, Prime Min..."
entries.dialogueText: "First of all, thank you, Prime Minister Sotelato for agreeing to stop this meaningless invasion."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""I'm sorry, but this is what the pe..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sorry, but this is what the people want. An end to this war."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Congratulations!""
entries.dialogueText: "Congratulations!"

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Are you sure? The parliament has a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you sure? The parliament has already agreed on this treaty. Everyone wants this war to be over."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""I will further remind you that you..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will further remind you that your signature isn't needed for this treaty to go into effect. It's a mere formality."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Fine. In the name of peace, I will..."
entries.dialogueText: "Fine. In the name of peace, I will sign the treaty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Regardless, I will not sign. Agree..."
entries.dialogueText: "Regardless, I will not sign. Agreeing to these terms is a mistake."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Adarfo shrugged."
entries.dialogueText: Adarfo shrugged.

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""So be it.""
entries.dialogueText: "So be it."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He and his ministers signed the pap..."
entries.dialogueText: He and his ministers signed the papers. The room broke out into halting applause.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I would have ordered the fighting..."
entries.dialogueText: "I would have ordered the fighting to continue. But I will not go against my Prime Minister's wishes."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""First of all, thank you, Prime Min..."
entries.dialogueText: "First of all, thank you, Prime Minister Sotelato for agreeing to stop this meaningless invasion."
